Eve M.: Drafting release notes for v0.10.1 — main items: default quantization profile change, smarter routing fallbacks, and a known issue with reranker score variance. Need a quick link sweep and SDK snippet QA.
Ravi S.: I'll verify Node/Python snippets and CI permalinks. Node opt-out one-liner ready.
Noor A.: Found a stale /docs/kb/caching link in the draft; suggest redirect to /docs/optimize/caching and add a prefix-cache anchor. I'll open a PR.
DocsBot: PR #934 opened by Noor A. — "fix(docs): redirects + prefix-cache anchor". CI: pending.
Eve M.: Good. Keep public known issue non-technical: "Reranker scores may vary slightly in some locales; results remain within tolerance." Add "How to opt out" examples and a rollback snippet for Dedicated.
Ravi S.: Snippets tested and PR #939 contains shortened Node example.
Eve M.: Final pass tonight; plan to publish tomorrow 09:00 PT if no more link or snippet issues. :rocket:
